title: What's Included in a Typical Home AC Installation Package? - Rosenberg Plumbing & Air
desc: Learn how to read your air conditioning installation quote and what to expect during install service with Rosenberg Plumbing & Air in San Antonio.

blocks.text: Replacing an air conditioner is a major investment. When you receive quotes, comparing them can be confusing if you’re not sure what they include. Understanding all aspects and inclusions of a typical AC installation package is the first step toward making an informed decision for your home.
Knowing what to look for helps you choose a reputable company that provides complete, high-quality service.
What Is Included in a Typical AC Installation Package?

A standard AC installation package includes the equipment, labor, and services required to replace your old system with a new one. The exact details can vary based on the type of system you choose and the specific needs of your home. However, a proper installation always follows a structured process.

From the initial home evaluation to the final system testing, every step is crucial for optimal performance. A transparent quote will clearly outline each of these services, so you know precisely what you are paying for.
New Air Conditioning Equipment
A standard central air conditioning system, or split system, consists of two main units. Your installation package will include this core hardware.
Removal of the Existing AC System

Before a technician can install the new system, they must carefully remove the old one. This process is more involved than simply hauling away old equipment. Our NATE-certified technicians follow strict procedures to remove and dispose of the old system safely and responsibly.

items: Recovering refrigerant for disposal or recycling

blocks.text: System Sizing and Load Calculations

One of the most critical steps in any AC installation is ensuring the new system is the correct size for your home. This involves more than square footage. An HVAC technician performs a detailed Manual J load calculation to find the perfect size.

items: Number, size, and placement of windows

blocks.text: Installation of New Components
This is the core of the physical work. Our experienced technicians install each component according to manufacturer specifications and local building codes.

items: Setting the outdoor unit on a level pad
Installing the sloped condensate drain line

blocks.text: Ductwork Evaluation

Your ductwork is the circulatory system for your HVAC equipment. If it’s leaky, poorly designed, or clogged, even the most efficient new air conditioner won’t cool your home effectively. A standard installation package includes a thorough inspection of your existing ductwork.

Our technicians will identify any signs of leaks, damage, or poor airflow that could compromise your new system’s performance. Based on this evaluation, we can determine whether simple repairs and sealing are sufficient or if the ductwork needs more significant modifications.
Thermostat Installation and Setup

A new thermostat is your primary interface with your cooling system. Many installation packages include a new programmable or smart thermostat. These modern controls offer greater precision and energy-saving features compared to older manual models.

Programmable thermostats run on a set schedule. Most smart thermostats allow for remote control via Wi-Fi. Some models can learn your habits, generate energy-use reports, or use geofencing to return to comfortable temperatures when household members return home. Once installed, we will help you set it up and make sure it is properly calibrated with your new air conditioner.
Startup, Testing, and Performance Verification

After installation, we perform a detailed commissioning process to verify that every component is working correctly. This quality-assurance step ensures that your system delivers the performance and efficiency you expect.

items: Checking all connections and electric components
Verifying the thermostat’s communication with the AC
Running a full cooling cycle test

blocks.text: Warranties and Manufacturer Registration

Your new air conditioner comes with valuable warranties that protect your investment. A professional installation package includes handling the registration paperwork for you. This is a critical step, as many manufacturers require timely registration to activate the full warranty terms.
Potential Add-Ons That May Not Be Included

While a standard package is comprehensive, some situations may require additional work or equipment that falls outside a typical installation. It’s important to clarify if your quote includes these. Some may be necessary for older homes.
We believe in transparency and will always discuss these potential needs with you up front. Be sure to check for our latest coupons and specials that may help with these valuable upgrades.
Questions to Ask Before Signing an Installation Agreement
To make sure you’re getting a complete and transparent quote, it helps to have a list of questions ready. A reputable company will be happy to provide clear answers.

items: Specific brand and model of equipment
Ductwork evaluation and potential repair costs
Use of a Manual J load calculation
